summary:
44x32 McMansion: a garage wing (x1..17) and a main block (x18..35) with a two-storey quartz portico under a tall cross-gable, plus a hipped family wing (x35..42) with a conical turret bay, all in dark-slate roofs.
Stone veneer lower front, birch siding above, quartz belt courses and quoins, black shutter strips, a 3x2 stone chimney, a wide driveway and a lawn with shrubs and a young tree, and a back deck.
17 rooms with exact boxes (foyer with an oak stair and a double-height void, upper gallery, bonus room over the garage); 6 parts, 36 ticked elements.

rooms.purpose: Big media/game room over the garage: sectional sofa facing a big TV, pool table, bar counter, arcade corner. Spruce floor, fun and loud.

concept_subject: A suburban McMansion seen from the cul-de-sac street, front facing the viewer. On the left, a wide three-car garage wing with three white carriage-style doors (small window panes along their tops), black-shuttered windows of a bonus room above, and a hipped dark asphalt-shingle roof with two dormers. Beyond it, in the middle, a two-storey beige-sided main block under a tall steep front gable in dark slate shingles. Below the gable, a double-height white portico with four tall quartz columns, a fanlighted double door with sidelights, and a big arched palladian window above it. Left of the portico, a small gabled dormer on the main roof. To the right, a hipped family wing whose front corner is a round-ish turret bay with a conical dark-slate cap and a thin finial, tall narrow arched windows, a big stone chimney on its back. The lower storey of the front is grey stone veneer (andesite, stone, cobblestone mix), with beige siding above, a white belt course between the storeys, white quoins at the corners, white window sills and hoods, and black shutters on the tall arched windows. A wide light-grey concrete driveway runs to the garage, with a stone-brick front walk to the portico, carriage lamp posts, a mailbox, a manicured lawn with rounded azalea shrubs and flower strips along the foundation, and a young oak with a stake on the right lawn. Behind, a spruce back deck with a railing. 44 wide, 32 deep, 14 tall.

parts.name: main shell
parts.scope: Grass over the whole site (y=0). Main block x18..35 z11..25, family wing x35..42 z12..24 and chamfered turret x38..42 z8..12: floors (y=0 and y=5 slab, with the foyer void x24..29 z12..16 left empty), walls y1..9, top plate y=9, interior partitions, the foyer oak stair, and every opening and arch in plan OPENINGS left as air. Uses wallBlock (veneer, siding, belt rows y=5 and y=9), quoins and shutterCells. The portico footprint and the chimney footprint stay empty.

All openings left as air.
